channel.title: Replaced by AI Layoff Tracker
channel.description: Recent sourced AI layoff tracker entries.

item.title: PayPal AI layoffs, September 3, 2026
item.description: PayPal: 220 layoffs. AI-adjacent restructuring. Reuters reported that PayPal cut roughly 220 jobs in India as part of a broader multi-year transformation focused on simplifying operations, improving productivity, and integrating AI and automation across the business.

item.title: WPP AI layoffs, September 1, 2026
item.description: WPP: 1,000 layoffs. AI-adjacent restructuring. Reuters reported, citing the Financial Times, that WPP is cutting up to 1,000 more jobs by year-end while accelerating a restructuring that brings major creative agencies under WPP Creative to harness AI.

item.title: Rapid7 AI layoffs, August 10, 2026
item.description: Rapid7: 300 layoffs. AI-adjacent restructuring. The Boston Globe reported that Rapid7 cut about 300 jobs, or roughly 12% of its workforce, as new CEO Wael Mohamed overhauls the cybersecurity company amid a focus on adding AI-powered features.

item.title: VideoAmp AI layoffs, August 7, 2026
item.description: VideoAmp: 55 layoffs. AI-adjacent restructuring. The Wall Street Journal reported that VideoAmp laid off roughly 20% of its staff, about 50 to 60 employees, as CEO Tony Fagan said the company is investing in agentic software development and becoming an AI-powered media performance platform.

item.title: E.W. Scripps AI layoffs, August 4, 2026
item.description: E.W. Scripps: 268 layoffs. Automation / efficiency cited. E.W. Scripps disclosed transformation-related job reductions affecting about 6% of its workforce, later identified as 268 jobs, while CEO Adam Symson said the transformation uses advanced technology, AI and automation to change operations and improve results.

item.title: Chime AI layoffs, July 31, 2026
item.description: Chime: 140 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Reuters reported that fintech company Chime is cutting 10% of its workforce, about 140 jobs, as it joins companies using AI-driven efficiencies to streamline operations.

item.title: BuzzFeed AI layoffs, July 28, 2026
item.description: BuzzFeed: 180 layoffs. Speculative / unclear. Futurism reported BuzzFeed announced layoffs of 180 employees, about one-third of its remaining workforce, in the latest sign of its decline since the company's pivot to AI.

item.title: Visa AI layoffs, July 28, 2026
item.description: Visa: 2,600 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. CNBC reported Visa plans to cut about 7% of its workforce, or roughly 2,600 employees, as CEO Ryan McInerney seeks to streamline the payments company while AI reshapes how work gets done.

item.title: Monday.com AI layoffs, July 26, 2026
item.description: Monday.com: 600 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. BitcoinWorld reported that Monday.com blamed AI for 600 layoffs, while The Tech Buzz reported that the work-management platform joined a group of major tech companies explicitly citing artificial intelligence as a driver for workforce reductions.

item.title: Patreon AI layoffs, July 23, 2026
item.description: Patreon: 93 layoffs. Speculative / unclear. TechCrunch reported that Patreon would lay off 20% of its workforce, or 93 people, after CEO Jack Conte said the company needed to respond to market changes and adjust its cost structure while noting that AI has fundamentally transformed the tech industry.

item.title: Thomson Reuters AI layoffs, July 13, 2026
item.description: Thomson Reuters: 500 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Reuters-backed reporting said Thomson Reuters would cut up to 500 engineering roles globally as the company aggressively deploys artificial intelligence across its businesses and shifts hiring toward senior, AI-native engineering roles.

item.title: Microsoft AI layoffs, July 6, 2026
item.description: Microsoft: 4,800 layoffs. AI reorg or spending linked. BBC reported that Microsoft announced 4,800 job cuts, roughly 2.1% of its workforce, with Xbox bearing a large share of the layoffs amid a significant restructure and Microsoft continuing to prioritize artificial intelligence spending.

item.title: Amperity AI layoffs, June 25, 2026
item.description: Amperity: – layoffs. Explicit AI cited. GeekWire reported that Amperity conducted layoffs as the customer data startup transforms its operations around AI, with the company saying the shift changes where it invests and the shape of the team it needs.

item.title: Elastic AI layoffs, June 24, 2026
item.description: Elastic: 281 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Elastic announced an organizational change including an approximately 7% workforce reduction, about 281 workers, while CEO Ash Kulkarni said advances in AI and automation are letting the company operate with leaner teams.

item.title: Snyk AI layoffs, June 24, 2026
item.description: Snyk: 90 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Globes reported that cybersecurity company Snyk is laying off about 90 employees in Israel and worldwide, while Cybernews reported that the company is reorganizing to prioritize its AI Security Platform development.

item.title: General Motors AI layoffs, June 22, 2026
item.description: General Motors: 1,300 layoffs. Automation / efficiency cited. Ars Technica reported that General Motors installed about 50 collaborative robot arms at Factory Zero while 1,300 workers remained out of work following a temporary layoff tied to idled EV production.

item.title: Oracle AI layoffs, June 22, 2026
item.description: Oracle: 21,000 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Oracle's FY2026 Form 10-K confirmed a drop from approximately 162,000 full-time employees at the end of FY2025 to approximately 141,000 at the end of FY2026, a 21,000-role reduction that BBC and CNBC reported in the context of Oracle's AI spending and restructuring.

item.title: Optimove AI layoffs, June 17, 2026
item.description: Optimove: – layoffs. Explicit AI cited. InterGame reported that Optimove CEO Pini Yakuel said the marketing services provider would cut 10% of staff in a push toward AI and train remaining employees to shape the next version of the company.

item.title: Robinhood AI layoffs, June 16, 2026
item.description: Robinhood: 290 layoffs. Speculative / unclear. Robinhood announced a reduction in force affecting approximately 10% of full-time employees, with reporting putting the cut at about 290 roles, as part of a push to stay lean, flatten layers, and accelerate product velocity.

item.title: Rackspace Technology AI layoffs, June 10, 2026
item.description: Rackspace Technology: 750 layoffs. Explicit AI cited. Rackspace Technology approved a workforce realignment expected to terminate approximately 15% of its global workforce, roughly 750 roles based on its latest reported 5,000-person employee base, as it deemphasizes legacy public-cloud service delivery and redeploys resources toward governed enterprise AI.
